results.diagnosis: r8 correctly detected the final bottom MOVE and blocked two later long-press attempts before execution, so no second move transaction was submitted. It then navigated to Ringtones, where one truncated nature_sounds_* file was visible. The official exact-path evaluator still returned 0. The source screen contained several near-duplicate nature_sounds names and the executor chose a tile from a truncated label without exact-name proof; the destination item therefore cannot be treated as nature_sounds.mp3. The completion critic independently rejected the final done claim because the full filename was not visible.

guard_assessment.successful_invariant: A second destination transaction was prevented before filesystem mutation.
guard_assessment.over_constraint: Blocking every post-commit long-press also prevented reversible selection for filename/details inspection in the destination.
guard_assessment.required_refinement: Allow reversible destination inspection, but block post-commit Move to/Copy to commands and duplicate bottom commits.

next_hypothesis.problem: Grid coordinates are not stable evidence for an exact filename when accessibility exposes multiple same-prefix variants and the screenshot truncates every label.
next_hypothesis.generic_fix: Before a Files long-press, compare the task-literal filename with full accessibility text and the nearest filename element at the proposed coordinate. Reject a mismatched or unprovable target and require search/list/detail recovery. This uses only the user-visible task literal and current UI, not evaluator state.
next_hypothesis.test_requirement: Unit-test exact versus suffix/prefix variants and integrate a same-screen repair that changes from a wrong grid long-press to search or another verifiable view.

decision: Preserve r8 and do not launch the formal eight-cell Gate E. A separate r9 may add exact-target coordinate adjudication and narrow the post-commit block from all long-presses to duplicate move/copy commands.
